head: dfe5caa713344b9a03ded3ba6bbe44867b7606d5
classification_reasons: Spec tightness: acceptance is measurable, but three flagged concerns are still open (spot REST host default with no switch, storage layout/zstd level unmeasured and moved to the build on synthetic data, assumptions A1-A12 with A10 the weightiest), and the intent's open question 3 is carried forward rather than answered.

Blast radius: a new package of eight modules plus two test modules and fixtures, the project's first runtime dependency (polars) in pyproject.toml, a change to the project CI install step, outbound network to three Binance hosts, and file writes/deletes in the owner's cache directory outside the repository. No risk-list item is touched.
Test coverage: nothing existing covers this code (app/ holds only __version__ and tests/ only the smoke test); every proof test is new in this change.

Sequencing: the design branch predates the owner's commit 801dc74 (commands.setup gains polars); this checkout's sdlc.yaml still reads 'python -m pip install pytest ruff'. The build must start from a base that holds 801dc74, which a design gate that waits for the owner's merge guarantees.
attempted: Intent: compared every intent bullet (two markets, Vision then REST fill, gap reporting, polars frame with the 11 kline columns, us/ms normalisation across 2025-01-01, Parquet-only cache, cache root priority, layout, atomic write, no-cache mode, cache-info/cache-clear, closed-day REST caching, CLI subcommands, 4-thread pool, timeouts, retries, 404/418 handling, REST pacing, urllib with injectable fetch, offline tests) to R1-R13, Design and Acceptance: each is covered; nothing nearby substituted. Not a quick intent, so no 'Assumed from the quick intent' list applies.

Intent open questions: Q1 (spot host, refused fill) answered by design choice and flagged; Q2 (gap shape) answered with KlineGapError carrying .gaps and .frame, consistent with 'never a silently short frame'; Q3 (daily vs larger files) carried forward to a build-time synthetic measurement and flagged; Q4 (codec) zstd level 3 and flagged. The intent asked the design to measure real BTCUSDT 1m; synthetic random-walk data may compress differently from real data, which the flagged concern covers for the owner.

Spec and plan: every requirement maps to a module in plan.md 'Files that change' and to a step in 'Order of work'; acceptance items map to the 16 named proof tests plus the per-module tests of steps 2-7. Flagged concerns are open, which is the panel's business under deferred review, not a reason here.

Proof: design phase, no toolchain logs or verifier report expected; the committed diff holds only the change folder (intent, spec, plan, status, hook log, run record). Runner records (run-design.json) not cited.

Blast radius: diff touches only changes/0001-.../ (no guardrail file, no source). The plan's future touches are pyproject.toml, .github/workflows/ci.yml (not a guardrail: sdlc.yaml protected_paths is [] and the always-protected list excludes it), app/data/**, tests/**. No risk-list item (auth, data migrations, money movement, production config) applies: public read-only market data, deploy.action none, no schema migration. Plan Risks name the CLAUDE.md staleness ('1 passed', setup line) per REVIEW.md's 'flag when CLAUDE.md is outdated' and leave the edit to the owner.

Policies: coding-standards rule 5 and security-baseline rule 6 (new dependency) have a plan.md Risks line; security-baseline rule 2 (validated params before URL/path, size bounds on zip body and member, checksum, member-name allow, REST JSON shape check, path containment, cache-clear restricted to the day-file pattern) is designed in; rule 3 no secrets (public endpoints); rule 7 tests offline through stub Fetch. data-conventions: all fields public market data, schema defined once, no migration. definition-of-done design items present except closed concerns (deferred to the panel).

Tests (design): proof tests as planned could pass with a bug in three places worth the build's attention, none a design defect: (a) 'spot and futures identical' only proves the floor conversion if the futures fixture uses ...999 ms close_time and the 2025 spot fixture ...999999 us; (b) the 429/5xx retry test must assert attempt count and recorded sleeps, not just eventual success; (c) the current-day test needs an injected clock, which step 8 names.
Skip markers: not checked at design (ratchets run at build and test).

Claims vs today's code (merge base = working tree at design): pyproject.toml has [project] with version 0.1.0, requires-python >=3.10, no dependencies, ruff line-length 100, testpaths ['tests'] - matches; app/__init__.py holds only __version__ = '0.1.0' - matches 'app/ has only __version__'; tests/test_smoke.py asserts app.__version__ == '0.1.0' - matches 'pins it'; .github/workflows/ci.yml installs pytest==9.1.1 ruff==0.16.9 then lint, test - matches 'pinned like them'; sdlc.yaml risk_list, sandbox.allowed_domains [], deploy.action none, plugin version 1.0.50 - match the spec header and policy text; policies/ holds only README.md and no .claude/skills overrides exist - matches 'overrides: none; policy sources: none'; no schemas/ folder - matches; docs/decisions/index.md does not exist in this project and the spec cites no project decision.

Claim 'commands.setup on the default branch is python -m pip install pytest ruff polars (801dc74)': this checkout's sdlc.yaml reads 'python -m pip install pytest ruff'; the delegation prompt confirms 801dc74 is on origin/main. The claim is about main, not this branch, and plan Risks says the build must take sdlc.yaml from main; consistent, recorded as a sequencing note in classification_reasons.

Claims vs external facts used by the design: spot Vision files in microseconds from 2025-01-01 (Binance public-data notice); spot REST limit max 1000, USD-M max 1500; per-minute weight limits 6000 spot, 2400 USD-M; X-MBX-USED-WEIGHT-1M header; 1s interval spot-only; um daily intervals 1m-1d; floor division of ...999999 us to ...999 ms equals the futures ms close_time; polars write_parquet(compression='zstd', compression_level=3) and Datetime('ms','UTC') exist. All consistent.

Feasibility note (not a reason): urllib.request.urlopen takes one timeout for connect and read; '10 s connect, 60 s read' needs a custom HTTPSConnection/handler that sets the socket timeout after connect, and the default fetch must convert urllib's HTTPError into HttpResponse(status=...) so the retry wrapper sees 4xx/5xx; header lookup for X-MBX-USED-WEIGHT-1M and Retry-After must be case-insensitive. All buildable within the plan's http.py.

Design soundness probes: gap grid vs current-day unfinished candle (dropped, A9); empty days not cached so pre-listing ranges re-request each load (accepted in Options not taken); A11 cache-clear defaulting to --market spot is a mild footgun for um data but deletes only matching day files under <cache>/binance-vision/ and is flagged; 418 cancels pending futures (running ones finish one request); Retry-After over 60 s stops instead of sleeping. None breaks behaviour, leaks data or breaches a policy.
Drive: commands.drive is empty; not applicable.
